audit.whatIsWrong: The packet is right twice over: the full layer never named a single Orianna ability except Command: Shockwave, and three places dropped the colon — "Command Shockwave" in spikes[1].text and late, "Command Attack" in wants.you[1] (plus "Shockwave" bare in whys[4] and wants.foe[2]).
audit.why: Riot's names are Clockwork Windup, Command: Attack, Command: Dissonance, Command: Protect and Command: Shockwave. The colon is part of the name.
audit.corrected: Colons restored everywhere, and Command: Attack, Command: Protect and Command: Dissonance now appear on the page with their real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Command: Protect was never mentioned, yet it is the ability that decides whether a Neeko all-in works. Riot's text: it attaches the Ball to an allied champion, shielding them, damaging enemies it passes through, and granting the holder additional Armor and Magic Resist.
audit.why: A braced Orianna is not just shielded — she is shielded plus armoured plus MR'd, on a flat 9-second cooldown. That is why the whole lane reduces to ball position rather than to any cooldown count.
audit.corrected: Written into enemyWin, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, dontsFull[2].d, report[3].t, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told the reader to "Punish poke windows only when Command Attack is down", and breakdown.cooldowns held no digit at all.
audit.why: Command: Attack is 7/6/5/4/3 seconds and costs a flat 35 mana. At rank 5 it is a three-second cooldown — waiting for it to be down is not a plan. The real window is the Ball's position, since Q leaves it at the target location.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries 110/95/80, the 3-second rank-5 Q and the flat 9-second E, and the page consistently says to read the ball rather than the cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side read "Skill" while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Orianna/Orianna/Neeko/Neeko/Skill/Skill/Orianna. Five of seven rows disagreed across the layers.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 are hers on range alone; level 3 is where Tangle-Barbs into Blooming Burst punishes a ball that has left her body; 6 is a genuine Shockwave-versus-Pop Blossom setup war; and two-plus items belongs to the better teamfight ultimate.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides brought onto the two agreeing sources, with each row's why and rating rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why asserted a "3-second knockup" the kit does not give.
audit.why: Nothing in Neeko's Pop Blossom text supports a duration. Catalogued defect 6 — magnitude without a source.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real level 6 dynamic: Command: Shockwave at 110s against Pop Blossom at 120s, with the ball position deciding who commits first.

audit.whatIsWrong: Orianna is female and the full layer called her "he/his/him" in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.trading, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].t, report[0].t, report[1].t, report[3].t, report[9].t, report[11].t and report[13].t.
audit.why: champ-gender lists orianna as female, and the content layer already says "her ball" throughout — so the page contradicted itself field to field.
audit.corrected: All fifteen regendered as part of their rewrites.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed: dosFull[0].d and dosFull[1].d carried the Shockwave line and the tradeGood string under unrelated titles, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d answered other titles, and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string. dontsFull[1].d also warned about "assassin timers" in a matchup against a control mage.
audit.why: Catalogued defect 2, plus a template that does not fit this enemy at all.
audit.corrected: All six bodies rewritten against their own titles and against Orianna specifically.

notes: NAME FIXES: the colon is part of Orianna's ability names; "Command Shockwave" and "Command Attack" appeared in spikes[1].text, late, wants.you[1], wants.foe[0], wants.foe[2] and whys[4], and the full layer never named Command: Attack, Command: Dissonance or Command: Protect at all. All corrected. wants.you[1] additionally gave bad advice — it told the reader to wait for Command: Attack to be down, but that ability costs a flat 35 mana and reaches a 3-second cooldown at rank 5, so the real window is ball position; the line now says so. CHART: all seven full-layer sides read "Skill" while content win[] and packet.levelChart agreed on Orianna/Orianna/Neeko/Neeko/Skill/Skill/Orianna. I brought full onto the agreeing pair — no content win[N] edit needed — and rewrote every why and rating alongside, including the two even rows whose sides did not move (their whys were pure template). FABRICATION REMOVED: phases[4].why claimed a "3-second knockup" that appears nowhere in Pop Blossom's text. PRONOUNS: fifteen full-layer fields called Orianna he/his/him while the content layer said "her" throughout. NOT ASSERTED: whether Command: Shockwave can be baited onto a Shapesplitter clone, and whether it can displace Neeko mid-Pop-Blossom preparation — neither is answerable from the kit text, so neither was written. DIFF FIELD: diff="EVEN" / 5.5-6/10 against a 56% win rate over 125 games reads a touch pessimistic; I did not guess at the diff enum's vocabulary.
